title: FlexSectionStatus
description: optionledger.flex_section_status r1: whether one section was in the statement of one alias in one fetch, with its row count and the rows refused; insert only. No account number is stored.

alias.description: Account alias of the statement, the label mapped by the allow-list.

section.description: Row element name of the section in the Flex statement, for example CashTransaction; a pattern, so a later section needs no schema change.

state.description: present: the statement has the section; absent: the Flex query lacks it.

row_count.description: Rows of the section stored or found unchanged; 0 when absent.

rows_refused.description: Rows refused for a missing key attribute or a duplicate key.

recorded_at.description: Instant the status was recorded, UTC.
